framework_lessons: Follow cash coverage before forecasting distributions.
assessment: EPD distribution growth and operating resilience are well supported, and disclosed return sensitivities broadly favor the thesis. The forecast of a Fed reversal after something breaks is less reliable: emergency liquidity and rate tightening coexisted. The article honestly recognizes China lockdown surprise and distinguishes local from final inflation peaks. Lightning capabilities progressed, but announced integrations do not prove the named retailers adopted them. Source text discloses an advisory role at a Bitcoin venture fund, relevant context for its technology enthusiasm.
verification_limitations: Captured website text is not an authenticated publication-date version.
Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
